line.en: little north from denmark with guitarist reinier baas, playing the album crossing currents. doors 17:30, music at 19:00; seats from 225 kr, and dinner in the jazz kissa bar if you book it.
line.de: little north aus dänemark mit gitarrist reinier baas, das album crossing currents. einlass 17:30, musik um 19:00; plätze ab 225 kr, essen in der jazz kissa bar auf vorbestellung.
